title: apium ternatum
intro: Apium ternatum, commonly known as a type of celery or small celery, is a plant species within the parsley family (Apiaceae) native to China. The health benefits of Apium ternatum include its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and aid in digestion. Therapeutically, Apium ternatum has been traditionally used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Apium ternatum include compounds like flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
